name: wandering-gradient-type
title: Wandering Gradient Type
description: A multi-stop gradient that drifts through the glyphs on a slow non-repeating noise path — background-position animated through keyframes that never land on the same offset twice in a row, so the colour never loops visibly.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Pastel

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
